description: Every room Dubai Table books across Dubai: kind, area, which nights are Dubai Table nights, whether an exact table can be chosen, zones with seat and minimum-spend ranges, no booking fee, booking page and 360° tour links. Each venue also carries facts: what it suits (birthdays, corporate and private events, groups, date night, beach or pool day), minimum spend per person and per table, largest group, private rooms or cabanas, dress code and opening hours. Pass occasion to get only the venues that suit it, best matches first.
